Native blade65px and original hand occlusion retained.

variants.name: Mặc ngọc · thanh hồn
variants.sourceGeometryAssessment: AI dark-jade/ivory/bronze edit keeps nominal same flag silhouette and pole. variants.name: Cổ thạch · ngũ vân
variants.sourceGeometryAssessment: Gray old stone with carved clouds kept as bare core comparison option. Raw right-panel FX is a thick ivory ring and was not selected; its review layer is transparent. New stone source/core, no old v2 bead.

variants.name: Vân ngọc · thanh quang
variants.sourceGeometryAssessment: New smooth pale gray bead with light carved cloud marks; separate two green-white wisps/motes placed above/below core. Source gear and FX are independent panels; visual design is a new celestial option, not a canonical colour claim.

variants.name: Huyền thạch · nội giới
variants.sourceGeometryAssessment: New gray-violet dark bead with fine cloud marks; violet arcs/motes are a separate layer. Source colour is AI artwork, not a local hue shift or a verified permanent canonical appearance.

variants.name: Huyền kim · thanh ngọc
variants.sourceGeometryAssessment: AI dark metal/jade/silver edit preserves nominal cart wheel/spike/chain geometry and separate thunder-beast panel from v2. Natural complete-cart resample110x92 receives one transparent top row in the baseline110x93 component canvas; source pixels are not stretched and floor remains200. Beast natural64x80 receives one transparent right column in65x80 frame. New edges/fringe vary, not exact geometry or canonical deployment/world scale.

variants.name: Huyền thiết · lôi lam

Whole-device width110 and beast height80 are uniform resamples; transparent component padding only retains baseline frame/origin110x93/(122,107) and65x80/(155,55), not stretching pixels. Actual art is blue-gray rather than purple; palette/name reflect source. Static deployment candidate, no exact geometry/footprint/collision/action claim.
